title: MilePlan plan.json
description: A project plan: milestones, their tasks, and optional scheduled payments. import_plan() in the database is the authority. This schema covers the shape; it can't express: unique keys, due dates that never go backwards in plan order, start_date not after end_date, real calendar dates, unique tasks after trimming, a payment's milestone naming a milestone key in the same plan, or amounts with at most 2 decimals. import_plan checks those and reports each with its path.

project.description: An omitted optional field is left unchanged on import.

milestones.description: In delivery order. due_date never goes backwards from one milestone to the next.

tasks.description: Tasks match by title on a re-import: a matching title keeps its status, a new title is added, a missing title is removed.

payments.description: Scheduled payment requests, matched by key on a re-import.

milestone.description: The key of a milestone in this plan.

key.description: Stable across revisions, so a re-import can tell changed apart from removed-and-added.

money.description: At most 2 decimals (checked by import_plan: JSON Schema multipleOf is unreliable with decimals).
